list.name: node_id
list.label: Nodo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT node_id FROM network_metrics ORDER BY node_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", latency_ms, jitter_ms FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", packet_loss_pct FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "time", throughput_down_bps / 1000000.0 AS throughput_down_mbps, throughput_up_bps / 1000000.0 AS throughput_up_mbps FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Satélites visibles, obstrucción y SNR bajo
panels.description: is_obstructed y snr_low (ADR-17) como series 0/1 superpuestas a satellite_count, para correlacionar visualmente caídas de satélites con eventos de obstrucción/señal baja (RF-33).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", satellite_count, is_obstructed::int AS is_obstructed, snr_low::int AS snr_low FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", latency_ms FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Handovers por hora
panels.description: SUM(handover_count) por hora vía la Continuous Aggregate net_hourly (ADR-16), para detectar eventos de handover sin depender de heurísticas de picos de latencia.

targets.rawSql: SELECT bucket AS "time", sum_handover_count AS handovers, sum_outage_duration_ms AS outage_ms FROM net_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(bucket) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY bucket

panels.title: Alineación de la antena
panels.description: tilt_angle_deg y apuntamiento real vs. deseado (ADR-18, dishGetStatus.alignmentStats), para correlacionar desalineación física (ej. viento) con picos de latencia/jitter.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", tilt_angle_deg, boresight_azimuth_deg, desired_boresight_azimuth_deg, boresight_elevation_deg, desired_boresight_elevation_deg FROM network_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND node_id IN ($node_id) ORDER BY time
